seed_fields.description: Score aligned distinct query terms against one document using BM25. Uses log1p((N-df+.5)/(df+.5)) IDF and tf*(k1+1)/(tf+k1*(1-b+b*dl/avgdl)). Query terms have unit weight. Counts are Python integers in [0,2**53]; corpus size is positive, df <= N, and sum(tf) <= document length. Average length and k1 are positive finite values <= 2**53; b is in [0,1]. Empty queries and zero-length documents score zero. Unseen terms may have df zero. Rejects nonfinite intermediates/results; inputs are unchanged. Caller supplies distinct-term alignment, corpus statistics and fitting populations. No tokenization, text normalization, fitting, labels, query weighting or task-specific policy. Positive IDF, exact lengths and (k1+1) scale are explicit; no bitwise Lucene-equivalence claim.
